battle.name: 努比亞戰役
battle.theater: 努比亞第二瀑布塞姆納一帶
battle.brief: 公元前1429年（低年代），埃及第十八王朝法老阿蒙霍特普二世即位初年沿尼羅河南征，深入努比亞第二瀑布塞姆納一線，擊潰不肯臣服的部落聯盟，恢復對庫施總督區的控制。卡面埃及月牙劍是青銅時代弧刃近身砍劈的典型，此時已讓位於直背青銅劍，但它代表的仍是埃及步兵以砍擊而非刺擊制敵的傳統。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場公元前1429年（低年代紀年）的努比亞戰爭，交戰的兩方是尼羅河下游的埃及王國與尼羅河中上游的努比亞諸邦。埃及一方是第十八王朝中央王國的全部國家機關：法老阿蒙霍特普二世是全軍最高統帥，埃及王國沒有獨立的野戰司令部，兵員、糧食、車馬與徵發都由王廷的軍官體系調度，南方的常設行政則是「庫施（Kush）總督區」，由「南地總督」在法老代表下主持，職責包括徵收黃金、維持邊境要塞、接待朝貢使團與安置降服的努比亞首長。前線要塞塞姆納、布赫、庫馬、米爾吉薩、賽伊島一線各由營長與埃及軍官率領守兵，另有梅德賈伊首領以附庸首長的身分率領弓手與輕裝步卒。梅德賈伊部族原居東沙漠與上努比亞，自古受埃及冊封徵召，充當邊軍、弓手與治安力量，是埃及南方軍制中一支歷史悠久的本地兵力；另有大量已編入埃及軍籍的庫施人步兵與船員隨軍服役。努比亞一方則是沿尼羅河自第一瀑布至第二瀑布乃至更上游的村落與氏族聯盟，沒有常備軍，也沒有統一指揮，平日以首長率領的弓手、投擲手與矛兵結成的戰鬥集團應付邊境衝突。這次不肯臣服、被埃及記錄稱為「叛」的首領，率領的正是這樣一支以弓與投擲棒為主力的武裝，並以沿河渡口、不設防的村落與崎嶇的河谷地形構成鬆散的抵抗網。埃及的宗主—附庸秩序在這次戰役之前已經鬆動，戰爭正是用一次遠征把它重新壓回去。
countriesEn: This Nubian war of 1429 BC, in the low chronology, was fought between the kingdom of Egypt on the lower Nile and the Nubian polities of the middle and upper river. On the Egyptian side stood the whole apparatus of the centralised state of the Eighteenth Dynasty. The pharaoh Amenhotep II was the supreme commander; Egypt had no independent field command, and troops, grain, horses and levies were all moved by officials of the royal administration. In the south there was a standing administrative unit, the viceroyalty of Kush, administered on the pharaoh's behalf by the overseer of the southern countries, whose duties included collecting gold, maintaining the frontier fortresses, receiving tribute missions and settling Nubian chiefs who had submitted. The frontier chain of Semna, Buhen, Kumma, Mirgissa and Sai Island was held by company commanders and Egyptian officers, and alongside them chiefs of the Medjay led archers and light infantry as feudatory commanders. The Medjay were a people of the eastern desert and upper Nubia, summoned by Egypt from ancient times to serve as frontier soldiers, as archers and as police, and they were a long-standing local element in the southern military system of Egypt; large numbers of Kushite infantry and boatmen were likewise enrolled in the Egyptian army. On the Nubian side there was a league of villages and clans along the Nile from the First Cataract to the Second Cataract and beyond, with no standing army and no unified command, meeting frontier trouble with war bands drawn from bowmen, throwers of throwing sticks and spearmen led by their own chiefs. The leader who refused submission and whom the Egyptian record calls a rebel commanded exactly such a force, armed mainly with bows and throwing sticks, and organised a loose network of resistance out of river crossings, undefended villages and broken valley terrain. The Egyptian order of suzerainty over Nubia had loosened before this campaign, and the war was the means of pressing it back into place.
people: 全場最關鍵的人當然是法老阿蒙霍特普二世。他登基之後第一年就南下征討，是十八王朝少數親自帶領主力深入尼羅河上游的王室；他以射術自負，善用複合弓，據傳在陣前指揮時以身先士卒著稱。底比斯王陵 KV35 內一幅罕見的場景，畫的是他獨自乘輕便戰車奔馳於努比亞式的山嶺與河谷背景之前，背景人物造型與書寫的象形文字都取自南方，是已知最早的「努比亞風景」式王室繪畫。這位法老的木乃伊由維克多·洛雷於1898年發現於 KV35 這座未被盜掘的墓中，是1881年代爾拜哈里皇家cache之後最完整的一批王室遺體之一，也讓這場征討的時代背景有了物質的落點。對手方面，埃及的卡爾納克銘文記下了一名不肯臣服的「叛首」，譯名多作捷亨（Tjehen），記載說法老將其擊敗，並把繳獲的弓、刀與擲器、豹皮、長頸鹿尾、象牙等戰利品帶回；這份清單是今日了解當時雙方兵器與戰利品品類的主要依據。埃及陣中還有幾類人物：南地總督一系的埃及文官，負責在戰前經營黃金通道與朝貢，戰後重新編排附庸名冊；各要塞的營長，實際看守塞姆納與布赫的城牆與糧秣；梅德賈伊首領，傳世記載中如胡伊（Huy）這位首領在阿蒙霍特普二世時代率領本地弓手與輕兵作戰，是埃及倚重的南方打手；以及隨軍的庫施籍步兵與船工。埃及學者喬治·賴斯納於1900年前後發掘布赫要塞，1930年代塞姆納亦被發掘，出土的守軍「口糧帳簿」與「人員名冊」把這些前線人物的日常補了出來。
peopleEn: The decisive figure is of course the pharaoh Amenhotep II. He campaigned south in the first year of his reign, one of the few rulers of the Eighteenth Dynasty to lead a main force in person deep into the upper Nile, and he was proud of his archery, handling the composite bow well, and is said to have led in person at the head of the fighting. A rare scene in the Theban tomb KV35 shows him alone in a light war chariot driving across a Nubian-looking landscape of hills and river valleys, with the background figures and the hieroglyphs both taken from the south; it is the earliest known royal painting of Nubia as a landscape. The mummy of this king was discovered by Victor Loret in KV35, a tomb never robbed, in 1898; it forms part of the most intact body assemblages to follow the royal cache of Deir el-Bahari found in 1881, and it gives the campaign of that year a material anchor. On the other side, the Karnak inscription names a rebel chief who would not submit, most often transliterated Tjehen, and records that the king defeated him and brought back the spoils: bows, knives and throwers, panther skins, giraffe tails and ivory. That list is the principal evidence for the kinds of weapons and spoils exchanged in the encounter. Several kinds of people served on the Egyptian side: the officials of the administration of the southern countries, who worked the gold routes and the tribute before the war and re-drew the list of feudatories afterwards; the company commanders who actually held the walls and the rations of Semna and Buhen; the chiefs of the Medjay, of whom Huy is named in the transmitted record as leading native archers and light troops under Amenhotep II, the southern shock troops on whom Egypt relied; and the Kushite infantry and boatmen serving in the column. George Reisner excavated the fortress of Buhen around 1900 and Semna was excavated in the 1930s, and the grain accounts and personnel rosters brought to light there filled in the daily round of these frontier figures.
kits: 卡面的埃及月牙劍（khopesh）在這一役並不是埃及線列部隊的制式兵器。它是自早王朝以來用於近身格殺的青銅弧刃單刃，刃口開在凸面，砍進人體或盾牌之後不必回抽，約在古王國末期到中王朝之際，便在軍用序列裡讓位給更直、更長、刃口更有效的直背青銅劍；到第十八王朝，軍中配發的是直背青銅劍，貴族與儀仗用劍甚至以金柄、銀柄鑲嵌，弧刃月牙劍在王陵與神廟的器物清單中多以禮器與遺物形式出現。所以把它放進這場戰役的裝備表，說的是它在埃及兵器譜系裡的位置：它代表「砍劈式」近身戰鬥的源頭，而努比亞戰役裡真正分生死的就是這類動作，只是主角換成了直背青銅劍。埃及遠征軍的裝備以複合弓為核心，這種弓自中王朝末與第二中間期由西亞傳入，弓臂以木、角、筋分層黏合，步兵用弓約一米，王室用弓更長，配以木杆、骨或石製鏃、銅鏃並加羽翎的箭。步兵的近戰兵器是窄刃銅斧、鋤與鑿改作斧形者、長矛與短矛，投擲棒在沙漠地帶的騷擾中廣泛使用；防護是包革的柳條矩形盾、鎧鱗甲與皮甲，第十八王朝的軍人形象中已常見鱗狀胸甲與頭盔。機動靠輕便雙輪戰車，一車御者與射手兩人，第十七王朝是一匹馬，第十八王朝改為雙馬並行；舟船方面，尼羅河上的軍艦自象島與阿斯旺的船廠出發，逆流靠拖纖，順流靠風與槳，載運人、糧與戰利品。努比亞方面的武裝以弓與投擲棒為主，投擲棒是那種木質、扁平的短擲器，用於標槍式的拋射；此外是矛、標槍與短刀。卡爾納克記載的繳獲清單正好把兩邊的裝備差異擺出來：埃及人收的是弓、刀、擲器、豹皮、長頸鹿尾與象牙，這些正是對方在河谷與沙漠間奔襲時倚仗的東西。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card was not the standard weapon of the Egyptian line troops in this campaign. It was a bronze single-edged sword of crescent curvature used in close combat from the Old Kingdom onward, its edge on the convex side so that it need not be withdrawn after striking a body or a shield, and by the end of the Old Kingdom and through the Middle Kingdom it had given way in field service to the straighter and longer straight-backed bronze blade. By the Eighteenth Dynasty the army carried straight-backed bronze swords, and the swords of the nobility and of ritual processions were even mounted in gold or silver; the curved khopesh survived in the lists of tomb and temple equipment mainly as a ceremonial object and a funerary item. To place it in the equipment table of this war is therefore to state its position in the Egyptian lineage of arms: it is the origin of close-combat hacking, and hacking is exactly what decided life and death in a Nubian campaign, only with the straight-backed blade in the place of honour. The core of the Egyptian expedition was the composite bow, a type that came into Egypt from western Asia at the end of the Middle Kingdom and during the Second Intermediate Period, its limbs built up in layers of wood, horn and sinew, about a metre in the hands of infantry and longer for the king, firing arrows with wooden shafts, bone, flint or bronze heads, and feather fletching. The close-combat weapons of the foot were narrow-bladed bronze axes, hoes and adzes reworked into axe forms, and long and short spears; the throwing stick was in wide use for harrying in the desert. Protection consisted of hide-covered wicker rectangular shields, scale corselets and leather armour, and in Eighteenth Dynasty representations the scale cuirass and the helmet are already usual. Mobility came with the light two-wheeled war chariot carrying a driver and an archer, drawn by one horse in the Seventeenth Dynasty and by a pair abreast in the Eighteenth. On the river, the warships left the boatyards at Elephantine and Aswan, tracking upstream against the current and running down before wind and oar, and they carried men, grain and spoils. The Nubian armament rested on the bow and the throwing stick, the latter a short flat piece of wood thrown like a javelin, together with spears, javelins and short knives. The list of booty from Karnak sets the two inventories side by side: what Egypt took away was precisely what the enemy used when raiding through the valleys and the desert, bows, knives, throwers, panther skins, giraffe tails and ivory.
tactics: 埃及的南方戰役是一整套以河運為骨架的行動。法老的隊伍自底比斯登船，順流而下抵達阿斯旺，再由象島進入第一瀑布水道，沿河道緩行北上，逐段接手邊境要塞的守備，並以一線船隊輸送步兵與糧秣；到了第二瀑布，塞姆納與庫馬隔河相望，布赫在下游東岸，河流在此被岩石峽谷夾住，寬處不過數百米，兩岸峭壁上的棧道與渡口構成真正的戰場。作戰上，埃及的車兵是打擊骨幹：輕便戰車在狹窄河谷中縱列前進，車上射手居高臨下壓制岸上與船上的人，國王往往自乘前車；步兵在後列陣，弓手在兩翼與正面形成火力，長矛手與持斧者護住車隊與射手之間的空隙；梅德賈伊的輕兵與庫施籍步兵擔任前哨、追擊與斷糧，遇游擊便散成游鬥小組，不戀戰地。南方的沙漠與山地把戰爭變成兩種兵力的競賽：埃及靠馬與車在開闊地追擊，努比亞人則靠熟悉水道、渡口與村落地形，在船隊前後與峽谷邊緣游走，等待埃及隊伍拉開、缺水缺糧、補給線一斷再行襲擊。埃及的對策是把水、糧與舟船控制在自己手裡：船隊始終保持在一起，營地設在有水的河灣，佔領渡口後即架設棧橋與臨時碼頭，並在要塞內儲存口糧，以塞姆納與布赫出土的守軍口糧帳簿可看出這種供應的規模。戰役不是一次決戰，而是「沿河推進—肅清—接管」的連續過程：擊潰不肯臣服的一支，押送其首與繳獲回孟斐斯與卡爾納克，重新登記附庸名冊，再繼續向北推進。遠征一旦結束，隊伍與船隊即循尼羅河順流而下，全程約八百至九百公里水路，把人員、黃金與戰利品帶回三角洲。
tacticsEn: The southern campaign of Egypt was an operation whose skeleton was river transport. The pharaoh's column embarked at Thebes, ran down to Aswan, entered the channels of the First Cataract from Elephantine, and moved slowly north along the river, taking over the frontier fortresses one by one, with a line of boats carrying the foot and the grain. At the Second Cataract Semna and Kumma faced each other across the water and Buhen stood on the east bank below, the river there pinched between rock cliffs, in places only a few hundred metres wide, with tracks and fords cut into the cliffs on either side forming the true battlefield. In method, the Egyptian chariot corps was the striking arm: light chariots advanced in column through the narrow gorges, the archers on board shooting down at men on the banks and on the boats, the king usually riding in the leading car; the infantry closed up in ranks behind, the archers covering the front and both flanks, the spearmen and axe-men guarding the gaps between the chariots and the archers. Medjay light troops and Kushite infantry served as scouts, as pursuers and as the hand that cut supply, breaking into small skirmish groups when ambushed and refusing to be drawn into a set-piece engagement. The desert and the hills of the south turned the war into a contest between two kinds of mobility: Egypt used horse and chariot to pursue across open ground, while the Nubians moved about the waterways, the fords and the villages, waiting until the Egyptian column had stretched out, run short of water and grain and had its line of supply cut, and striking then. Egypt's answer was to keep water, grain and boats in its own hands. The flotilla stayed together, the camp was pitched at a bend with water, each ford taken was followed by a trestle and a temporary landing stage, and grain was stored inside the fortresses, and the scale of that supply can be read in the grain accounts of the garrisons of Semna and Buhen. The campaign was not a single decisive battle but a continuous process of pushing up the river, clearing, and taking over: break the force that would not submit, carry its chief and the booty back to Memphis and Karnak, re-register the list of feudatories, and go on north. When the expedition ended, the column and the flotilla went down the Nile again, some eight hundred to nine hundred kilometres of water, bringing men, gold and spoils back to the delta.
data: 這場戰役可以核對的數字分四類。第一類是紀年：任務所列的公元前1429年對應的是「低年代」——即把第十八王朝整體下移的現代紀年——之下阿蒙霍特普二世在位的頭一年；在沿用較早「高年代」的舊系年裡，同一次征討被安置在圖特摩斯三世晚年的位置，該王的努比亞遠征有完整的三十二年與三十三年紀錄，可與本役互為參照。法老在位長短在兩種系年下相差頗多，說法約在四十至五十餘年之間。第二類是埃及文獻中留下的編號與名錄：圖特摩斯三世的努比亞戰役記錄附有征服城鎮的名單，數目在百座以上；第十八王朝有「南地職員名冊」一類的行政文件，記載南地總督、梅德賈伊首領與各地首長的職銜與供職情況；阿蒙霍特普二世在卡爾納克的銘文記下本役繳獲的戰利品品類。第三類是考古數字：象島與阿斯旺是南方船廠與關卡的所在；塞姆納、布赫、庫馬、米爾吉薩等要塞經二十世紀初至二十世紀中葉的系統發掘，布赫要塞由賴斯納主持、塞姆納於1930年代發掘，出土守軍口糧帳簿與人員名冊；王陵 KV35 由洛雷於1898年發現，阿蒙霍特普二世木乃伊即在其中，而1881年代爾拜哈里王室藏窖是更早的一批王室木乃伊聚集地。第四類是必須打折扣的推估：遠征軍的具體人數沒有留下可信數字，同期第十八王朝野戰軍一般只能按數千至數萬的量級理解，其中本土附庸與附屬兵力比例偏高；由底比斯至第二瀑布的水路約八百至九百公里，亞斯旺至瓦迪哈勒法的河段約兩百公里；第一瀑布至第二瀑布的行政地帶本身全長約一百八十至二百公里，而塞姆納與庫馬隔河相望，兩堡之間的河面最窄處不過數百米。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked for this war fall into four classes. The first is chronology. The year 1429 BC given for the campaign corresponds to the first year of Amenhotep II's reign under the low chronology, the modern dating that shifts the whole Eighteenth Dynasty downward. Under the older high chronology the same expedition is placed in the closing years of Thutmose III, whose Nubian campaigns are documented for his years 32 and 33 and can be used as a parallel. The length of the pharaoh's reign differs considerably between the two chronologies, and is given variously as between forty and rather more than fifty years. The second class is the numbering and the rosters preserved in the Egyptian documents. The record of Thutmose III's Nubian campaigns carries a list of the towns subdued, numbering more than a hundred; the Eighteenth Dynasty has administrative files of the kind known as the rosters of officials of the south, giving the titles and the service of the overseer of the southern countries, of the Medjay chiefs and of the local chiefs; the inscription of Amenhotep II at Karnak records the kinds of booty taken in this campaign. The third class is archaeological. Elephantine and Aswan held the southern shipyards and the checkpoints. The fortresses of Semna, Buhen, Kumma and Mirgissa were systematically excavated between the beginning of the twentieth century and its middle, Buhen under Reisner and Semna in the 1930s, yielding the grain accounts and personnel rosters of the garrisons. The royal tomb KV35 was found by Loret in 1898 and held the mummy of Amenhotep II, and the royal cache of Deir el-Bahari opened in 1881 is an earlier concentration of royal mummies. The fourth class is estimate and must be discounted. No credible figure survives for the size of the expedition; a field army of the Eighteenth Dynasty can only be understood as being in the range of thousands to tens of thousands, with a high proportion of feudatory and subject troops. The water distance from Thebes to the Second Cataract is about eight hundred to nine hundred kilometres, and the river reach from Aswan to Wadi Halfa about two hundred. The administrative zone from the First to the Second Cataract is itself some one hundred and eighty to two hundred kilometres long, and Semna and Kumma face each other across the river, the channel narrowing at its tightest to a few hundred metres.
cause: 開戰的原因有四層，一層比一層實在。最表層是王位交替的常規：阿蒙霍特普二世剛剛登上王位，第十八王朝的南方秩序在他父親與祖父手中維持了一個多世紀，業已鬆動，他必須用一次成功的遠征昭示王權的延續，否則邊境會把這位新王視為軟弱。往下是具體的行政層面：圖特摩斯一世與圖特摩斯三世三代留下來的「庫施總督區」體制——即由南地總督治理、以要塞鏈控制河道、以附庸名冊登記首長——在第十八王朝中段已大不如前，貿易秩序一度中斷，關鍵是要塞的守兵與口糧常常不足，埃及的黃金來源因此受影響。再往下一層是威脅的具體形態：一位「叛」首率領的部落聯盟不再按期進貢，也不聽從招喚，此人還能整合沿河與東沙漠的武裝，把襲擊範圍拉到第一瀑布附近的村莊與商路上，使埃及無法只在邊境線上做防守。最深的一層是經濟：努比亞是埃及黃金、象牙、豹皮、長頸鹿尾與狒狒的主要來源，遠征隊伍本身也是一條採購線，王廷需要黃金來維持底比斯與孟斐斯的工程、軍費與外交；所以這場戰爭在財政上是一筆必要開支。於是「叛首」必須被制服，附庸名冊必須被重抄，沿河黃金必須重新流動，而這三件事恰好都指向一次順尼羅河而下的武裝遠征：前人三次都這樣做過，這一次只是照舊例再做一遍。
causeEn: The reasons for the war work in four layers, each more solid than the one above. The outermost is the routine of a change of kingship. Amenhotep II had just taken the throne, the southern order of the Eighteenth Dynasty had stood for more than a century under his father and his grandfather and had loosened, and he had to show by one successful expedition that the royal power continued, or the frontier would take the new king for a weak one. Below that lies the administrative layer: the system of the viceroyalty of Kush, left by Thutmose I and Thutmose III and their successors, in which an overseer of the southern countries governed the region, a chain of fortresses controlled the river and a roll of feudatories registered the chiefs, had by the middle of the Eighteenth Dynasty fallen well behind its earlier state, the flow of trade had been interrupted, and the garrisons and their rations were often insufficient, which affected the supply of gold to Egypt. A layer deeper still is the concrete shape of the threat: a leader called a rebel, heading a league of clans, had stopped sending tribute and stopped answering summons, and was able to weld together fighters from along the river and from the eastern desert, carrying raids back to the villages and the caravan roads near the First Cataract, so that Egypt could not simply hold the frontier line. The deepest layer is economic. Nubia was the main source of gold, ivory, panther skins, giraffe tails and baboons for Egypt, and the expedition was itself a supply line; the court needed gold to pay for the works at Thebes and Memphis, for the army and for diplomacy. So the rebel had to be beaten, the roll of feudatories rewritten and the gold moving down the river again, and all three of those point in the same direction, to an armed expedition moving up the Nile. The predecessors had done it three times; this time it was simply done again according to the custom.
impact: 戰役的直接後果是南方邊界被重新整理：塞姆納、庫馬、布赫、米爾吉薩一線的要塞體系恢復運作，守軍與口糧重新登記，沿河的附庸首長名冊被重抄，黃金與象牙重新成批北上，法老的南部遠征從此成為年例制度，「每年去庫施一趟」的做法在卡爾納克與後來阿瑪納時代的檔案裡留下固定格式，十八王朝後期與第十九王朝的南方政策都建立在這條慣例之上。更深一層的影響在兵器與戰術：南方遠征把埃及的車兵、弓兵與附庸輕兵組成一套可在狹窄河谷運作的戰鬥體系，也讓梅德賈伊這類本地武力從邊防治安隊伍變成常備的野戰與後勤力量；而「叛首」繳獲清單所反映的兩邊裝備差異，長期影響埃及對付沙漠游擊的辦法。政治上，這次勝利鞏固了阿蒙霍特普二世作王的正統，使他得以在即位頭十年裡把注意力轉向黎凡特與幼發拉底，第十八王朝的國際高點正建立在這一連串運作之上；反過來說，若南方失控，底比斯的財源與王朝正統都會受損。考古與後世知識的層面也一樣重要：塞姆納與布赫的發掘讓「守軍口糧帳簿」這類文件進入研究視野，KV35 的發現把這位法老的形象、其戰車與其南方戰役一併固定下來，而阿蒙霍特普二世在位初年的這次征討，正是後來學者為第十八王朝分期時使用的時間座標之一。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that the southern frontier was put in order again. The chain of fortresses from Semna and Kumma to Buhen and Mirgissa was back in working order, the garrisons and their rations were registered anew, the roll of Nubian feudatory chiefs along the river was rewritten, and gold and ivory began to move north in batches. The king's expedition to the south became an annual custom, and the practice of going to Kush every year took a fixed form in the records of Karnak and in the archives of the Amarna age; the southern policy of the later Eighteenth and the Nineteenth Dynasties was built on that custom. At a deeper level the war affected arms and method. The southern expedition assembled the Egyptian chariots, archers and feudatory light troops into a fighting system that could work inside a narrow river gorge, and it turned the Medjay from a frontier police force into a standing body of light infantry and support. The difference in equipment between the two sides revealed by the list of the rebel's booty long shaped the Egyptian answer to desert raiding. Politically, the victory confirmed the legitimacy of Amenhotep II's accession and allowed him to turn his attention within the first decade of his reign to the Levant and to the Euphrates, and the international high point of the Eighteenth Dynasty rests on that series of operations; conversely, had the south slipped out of hand, both the finances of Thebes and the legitimacy of the dynasty would have been damaged. The archaeological and intellectual legacy is no less real. The excavations of Semna and Buhen brought documents of the kind of the garrison grain accounts into view, the discovery of KV35 fixed at once the image of this king, his chariot and his southern war, and this campaign of the opening years of Amenhotep II's reign is one of the chronological markers used by scholars when they periodise the Eighteenth Dynasty.
result: 結果可以分三層來講。第一層是戰場上的結局：不肯臣服的一支被打散，首領為埃及所擒或為其部眾所棄，卡爾納克的銘文記下繳獲的弓、刀與擲器、豹皮、長頸鹿尾與象牙被帶回底比斯陳列，這份清單本身就是對南方首領的震懾。第二層是政治上的結算：附庸名冊重抄，貢賦恢復，要塞修復並重新配給守兵與口糧，庫施總督區的運作回到常軌；這次戰役沒有留下關於戰俘人數、陣亡人數的可信記載，能確定的是埃及在南部重新取得了主動權，並且是以一場短的、沿河的遠征取得，而非長期的消耗戰。第三層是最耐人尋味的：這次遠征並沒有終結努比亞的抵抗，它只是把抵抗推回下一次遠征之前；此後圖特摩斯四世、阿蒙霍特普三世、塞提一世、拉美西斯二世都曾再度南征，努比亞的統一與「庫施之王」的名號在第十八王朝末慢慢成形，最終在第二十五王朝以另一種方式回到埃及，而阿蒙霍特普二世這場公元前1429年的戰鬥，正是那一長串南方遠征中記錄最簡陋、卻把制度訂下來的一次。因此它的意義不在一時勝負，而在於它示範了後來一千年埃及對付南方時的標準做法：派一隊帶車、帶弓、帶船的人沿河而上，把不肯交出黃金的人打服，再把帳冊與名冊重新抄一遍。
resultEn: The result can be told in three layers. The first is the outcome on the ground: the force that would not submit was broken up, its chief was either taken by Egypt or abandoned by his own people, and the inscription at Karnak records that the bows, the knives and throwers, the panther skins, the giraffe tails and the ivory that were captured were brought back to Thebes and displayed, and that list was in itself the deterrent worked on the chiefs of the south. The second is the political settlement: the roll of feudatories was rewritten, the tribute resumed, the fortresses repaired and once more supplied with garrisons and grain, and the machinery of the viceroyalty of Kush returned to its routine. This campaign left no trustworthy account of prisoners or of dead, and what can be established is that Egypt regained the initiative in the south, and that it did so in a short river expedition rather than in a war of attrition. The third layer is the most instructive. The expedition did not end Nubian resistance; it only pushed the resistance back until the next expedition. Thutmose IV, Amenhotep III, Seti I and Ramesses II all campaigned south again, the unification of Nubia and the title of king of Kush took shape towards the end of the Eighteenth Dynasty, and in the Twenty-Fifth Dynasty it came back to Egypt in another guise. The fight of 1429 BC under Amenhotep II was the most poorly recorded of that long series of southern campaigns and one of the ones that fixed the institutions. Its meaning therefore lies less in the outcome of a single year than in the demonstration it gave of what would be the standard Egyptian method for the next thousand years: send a force with chariots, bows and boats up the river, beat those who will not hand over their gold, and then write the accounts and the registers out again.
